title: Sword & Sorcery: Immortal Souls
subtitle: Tactical high-fantasy dungeon crawl with deep enemy AI and soul progression
tagline: Awaken from the sleep of death to vanquish the darkness
loreSummary: You are legendary heroes resurrected from death by ancient divine rites. With fragmented souls and forgotten powers, you must rise together to purge the corrupted horrors terrorizing the Coast of Talon.
keyFeatures: Intelligent enemy AI system with unique behavior routines
Persistent soul-leveling and customized hero power ascension
Ethereal Ghost Soul form eliminates true player elimination
Branching narrative storybook driven by the Book of Secrets

ss_core.name: Core Campaign (Act I: Immortal Souls)
ss_core.description: The complete core story arc spanning all 7 Act I quests from awakening at the Altar of Souls to the epic battle against the supreme darkness general.

ss_arcane_portal.name: Extended Act I (Immortal Souls + Arcane Portal)
ss_arcane_portal.description: The core 7 Act I quests plus 4 challenging side-quest expeditions from the Arcane Portal expansion.

ss_full_saga.name: Complete Immortal Saga (Acts I & II)
ss_full_saga.description: The grand multi-box campaign combining Act I (Immortal Souls), Arcane Portal side quests, and the climactic Act II (Darkness Falls) finale.

milestones.title: Resurrection & The Undead Crypts
milestones.phase: Act I - Awakening of the Immortals
milestones.description: Awakening at the Altar of Souls with fragmented memories to cleanse the subterranean crypts beneath the Talon Coast.

milestones.title: The Orcish Onslaught
milestones.phase: Act I - The Outskirts of Chaos
milestones.description: Venturing into the hostile wilderness to crush marauding orc warbands and recover sacred stolen relics.

milestones.title: Defenders of the Realm
milestones.description: Holding the fortress battlements against a terrifying siege of corrupted monstrosities and shadowy puppet masters.

milestones.title: The Climax of Immortal Souls
milestones.description: Confronting the supreme dark overlord in an epic showdown to seal the rift and liberate the Talon Coast.
